items.title: Candoli interviewed by Monk Rowe, 1997
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] “Something for Liza.” [INTERVIEWEE] “Something for Liza” sure. Okay that’s on VSOP. You know what, he sent me some of those CD’s and I kind of like it.

ctx.x: “Something for Liza” sure. Okay that’s on VSOP. You know what, he sent me some of those CD’s and I kind of like it. I mean it’s almost like what I’m doing today but it’s a little different. © Fillius Jazz Archive -15-
You had your own tune on it.
